# Landing fixtures

`hero.html` is the draft hero whose real `petals check` run is the frame on petals' landing page (index.html): one slip an agent makes in each dimension the check reads (a font outside the brand, a framework blue, off-scale spacing and radius, a pure black shadow, a forbidden term, placeholder copy and a link to nowhere). tests/landing-frame.spec.sh re-runs the check against `../brand-plotplot-v1.11.0/` and compares it with the frame.
